nodes.label: Sentinel Phase 2.5 ("Advise") Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Owner decision of 2026-09-17: the LLM makes BUY/SELL/HOLD/WAIT and timing decisions from validated candidates. It expressly refines PRD §6.7's narration-only reading without making deterministic sizing, scores, taxes, caps, staleness or approval optional.

nodes.label: src/advisor/ Layer
nodes.rationale: Consumes explicitly projected read-only engine/context DTOs; pure engine and sizing computations are allowed for offline replay but persistence helpers, broker adapters and arbitrary SQL writes are not.

nodes.label: Advisor Capability Firewall
nodes.rationale: Capabilities are split rather than imports prohibited: separate proposal, replay and news writers, with an owner-action service outside src/advisor/ as the only path that converts a proposal into a paper request. Architecture tests must cover transitive paths and injected capabilities, not just direct import strings.

nodes.label: advisor_proposals (immutable)
nodes.rationale: Signed/dismissed status is derived from append-only decision events; there is no UPDATE of a supposedly append-only payload/status row. Unavailable token usage is NULL, never an invented zero.

nodes.label: News Ingestion (news_events / news_fetch_runs)
nodes.rationale: NSE announcements and business-news RSS are candidate sources needing real format fixtures and symbol resolution before being called supported; corrections append a superseding event and weekend news is still fetched because news does not follow the NSE calendar.

nodes.label: Fetch Coverage Semantics
nodes.source_location: Honest data coverage and failure semantics
nodes.rationale: A successful empty fetch means 'no matching news in that scope', not feed failure and not proof no adverse event exists. Freshness is measured from successful coverage checks, never the latest article timestamp, so a dead feed cannot masquerade as a quiet market.

nodes.label: Versioned Sentiment Classification
nodes.rationale: Reclassification appends and readers select the latest available by their own cutoff, not latest now. Unresolvable identity is flagged unresolved, never coerced to NEUTRAL/LOW, and no sentiment numeric output feeds engine scores. A buyback is not necessarily positive.

nodes.label: Deterministic Actionable Sizing
nodes.rationale: Missing capability: allocation drift paise is not a general satellite/exit unit sizer, and a signal score is not a budget. The combined selected batch plus outstanding reservations must be validated so two individually safe candidates cannot spend the same money.

nodes.label: Point-in-Time Deterministic Replay
nodes.rationale: Cuts off both economic and availability/ingestion timestamps so a late import carrying an old as_of cannot leak backward; never replays today's watchlist or portfolio across old dates as point-in-time.

nodes.label: Retrospective Experiment Caveat
nodes.rationale: Running a new model over old news is a retrospective experiment with training-data leakage, model drift and nondeterminism — not a point-in-time backtest, not an exact reproduction, and not free.

nodes.label: LLM Selects, Code Sizes and Gates
nodes.rationale: The LLM chooses an eligible (candidateId, action, timing); deterministic code attaches the exact supported size and rechecks hard gates. Selection is not a numeric score or size input, HOLD/WAIT creates no order, and negative news alone cannot manufacture an eligible SELL or override a minimum hold.

nodes.label: Task 6: LLM ADVISE + Gated Paper Handoff
nodes.rationale: Sign-off creates a fresh Phase 2 request through an external authorized adapter and cannot itself approve an order; monthly caps, paper mode and freeze/breaker apply across all recommendation sources, with no separate advisor quota.

nodes.label: System No-Action vs LLM HOLD/WAIT
nodes.rationale: A missing key, timeout or malformed LLM result is recorded as unavailable — never neutral sentiment or a confident HOLD — so an outage can never be read as a considered decision to do nothing.

nodes.label: Task 7: Calibration by Conviction and Horizon
nodes.rationale: Counts distinct eligible recommendations, not 3/6/12m observations as three independent calls; provisional minimum N=20 per bucket, unelapsed outcomes excluded with reasons rather than counted as misses, and retrospective replay is never mixed into the forward scorecard.

nodes.label: Task 8: Bounded Commentary
nodes.rationale: ≤300 words/section with numeric claims bound to a specific input field, unit, subject and period, because a regex checking that a numeral occurs somewhere in JSON is a lint, not semantic validation — the right number can name the wrong company, sign or period.

nodes.label: Task 9: Owner-Signed Quarterly Watchlist Revision
nodes.rationale: Removals evaluate watchlist evidence, not only sell triggers on owned positions, and insufficient history is not a failure signal. Append-only watchlist history must not be UPDATE-d to set removed_on — add a version/event representation rather than disabling audit protection.

nodes.label: Task 10: Web /advisor Surface
nodes.rationale: Shows system no-action separately and offers no approval button for a HOLD/WAIT order that does not exist; rating review and G-sec reminders stay flagged as unresolved manual coverage.

nodes.label: Known Data Coverage Gaps
nodes.rationale: Unavailable 2026 index-series feed, no EV/EBITDA or own 5y P/E history, partial fundamental/identity coverage, aggregate rather than complete FIFO lots, and a static owner-provided G-sec value. No source or model fills these from recall to make a recommendation pass.

nodes.label: Phase 2.5 Owner Inputs Gate
nodes.source_location: Owner inputs before the affected capability is enabled
nodes.rationale: Satellite per-action sizing budget, news source scope and freshness SLA, manual rating/G-sec review cadence, and shortlist regeneration must come from the owner; the plan withholds the affected capability rather than inventing a default.
